brass_spring.name: Brass Spring
brass_spring.desc: Ballistics component. Drives triggers and clockwork.

ratchet_housing.name: Ratchet Housing
ratchet_housing.desc: Ballistics component. A pawl-and-ratchet case that holds a trigger's timing.

rifled_barrel.name: Rifled Barrel
rifled_barrel.desc: Ballistics component. Bored and spiral-cut iron.

clockwork_trigger.name: Clockwork Trigger
clockwork_trigger.desc: Ballistics component. Spring and ratchet in one sealed lock. The heart of a repeater.

percussion_lock.name: Percussion Lock
percussion_lock.desc: Ballistics component. Hammer and nipple for cap ignition.

pressure_valve.name: Pressure Valve
pressure_valve.desc: Steamworks component. Lets a boiler breathe before it bursts.

steam_gauge.name: Steam Gauge
steam_gauge.desc: Steamworks component. A brass dial behind glass.

pocket_boiler.name: Pocket Boiler
pocket_boiler.desc: Steamworks component. A coal-fired boiler small enough to carry. Drives lances and mauls.

voltaic_cell.name: Voltaic Cell
voltaic_cell.desc: Galvanics component. Copper, zinc and brine in a jar. Stored lightning, no magic involved.

insulated_wire.name: Insulated Wire
insulated_wire.desc: Galvanics component. Copper wire wrapped in resin-soaked cloth.

induction_coil.name: Induction Coil
induction_coil.desc: Galvanics component. Turns a cell's trickle into a spark.

ground_lens.name: Ground Lens
ground_lens.desc: Optics component. A glass blank ground true.

black_powder.name: Black Powder
black_powder.desc: Demolition component. Saltpetre, sulphur and charcoal. Keep it dry and keep it away from shrines.

fuse_cord.name: Fuse Cord
fuse_cord.desc: Demolition component. Burns at a steady hand's-breadth a second.

gear_train.name: Gear Train
gear_train.desc: Automata component. Meshed brass gears on a frame.

automaton_frame.name: Automaton Frame
automaton_frame.desc: Automata component. An iron skeleton for a small machine.

clockwork_core.name: Clockwork Core
clockwork_core.desc: Automata component. Mainspring, escapement and governor. A machine's will, such as it is.
